preconditions.description: The number of people in the tree is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= n or ri == 0 for ri in r)
preconditions.description: Each person's parent is either another person in the tree or 0 if the person has no parent.
The number of queries is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= pi <= n for vi, pi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of a person number and a cousin level, both between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of answers matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in answers)
all(0 <= answer <= n-1 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer less than the number of people.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == sum(1 for j in range(1, n+1) if j != vi and is_pth_cousin(vi, j, pi, r)) for vi, pi, answer in zip([vi for vi, pi in queries], [pi for vi, pi in queries], answers))
postconditions.description: Each answer correctly counts the number of pi-th cousins of person vi.
